42/*!



43 * @file MPC5744P.h



44 * @version 1.2



45 * @date 2019-04-12



46 * @brief Peripheral Access Layer for MPC5744P



47 *



48 * This file contains register definitions and macros for easy access to their



49 * bit fields.



50 *



51 * This file assumes BIG endian system.



52 */



53



54/**



55* @page misra_violations MISRA-C:2012 violations



56*



57* @section [global]



58* Violates MISRA 2012 Advisory Rule 2.3, local typedef not referenced



59* The SoC header defines typedef for all modules.



60*



61* @section [global]



62* Violates MISRA 2012 Advisory Rule 2.5, local macro not referenced



63* The SoC header defines macros for all modules and registers.



64*



65* @section [global]



66* Violates MISRA 2012 Advisory Directive 4.9, Function-like macro



67* These are generated macros used for accessing the bit-fields from registers.



68*



69* @section [global]



70* Violates MISRA 2012 Required Rule 5.1, identifier clash



71* The supported compilers use more than 31 significant characters for identifiers.



72*



73* @section [global]



74* Violates MISRA 2012 Required Rule 5.2, identifier clash



75* The supported compilers use more than 31 significant characters for identifiers.



76*



77* @section [global]



78* Violates MISRA 2012 Required Rule 5.4, identifier clash



79* The supported compilers use more than 31 significant characters for identifiers.



80*



81* @section [global]



82* Violates MISRA 2012 Required Rule 5.5, identifier clash



83* The supported compilers use more than 31 significant characters for identifiers.



84*



85* @section [global]



86* Violates MISRA 2012 Required Rule 21.1, defined macro '__I' is reserved to the compiler



87* This type qualifier is needed to ensure correct I/O access and addressing.



88*/



89

91   -- MCU activation



92   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */



93



94/* Prevention from multiple including the same memory map */



95#if !defined(MPC5744P_H_)  /* Check if memory map has not been already included */



96#define MPC5744P_H_



97#define MCU_MPC5744P



98



99/* Check if another memory map has not been also included */



100#if (defined(MCU_ACTIVE))



101  #error MPC5744P memory map: There is already included another memory map. Only one memory map can be included.



102#endif /* (defined(MCU_ACTIVE)) */



103#define MCU_ACTIVE



104



105#include <stdint.h>



106



107/** Memory map major version (memory maps with equal major version number are



108 * compatible) */



109#define MCU_MEM_MAP_VERSION 0x0100u



110/** Memory map minor version */



111#define MCU_MEM_MAP_VERSION_MINOR 0x0002u



112



113/* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------



114   -- Generic macros



115   ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- */



116



117/* IO definitions (access restrictions to peripheral registers) */



118/**



119*   IO Type Qualifiers are used



120*   \li to specify the access to peripheral variables.



121*   \li for automatic generation of peripheral register debug information.



122*/



123#ifndef __IO



124#ifdef __cplusplus



125  #define   __I     volatile             /*!< Defines 'read only' permissions                 */



126#else



127  #define   __I     volatile const       /*!< Defines 'read only' permissions                 */



128#endif



129#define     __O     volatile             /*!< Defines 'write only' permissions                */



130#define     __IO    volatile             /*!< Defines 'read / write' permissions              */



131#endif



132



133



134/**



135* @brief 32 bits memory read macro.



136*/



137#if !defined(REG_READ32)



138  #define REG_READ32(address)               (*(volatile uint32_t*)(address))



139#endif



140



141/**



142* @brief 32 bits memory write macro.



143*/



144#if !defined(REG_WRITE32)



145  #define REG_WRITE32(address, value)       ((*(volatile uint32_t*)(address))= (uint32_t)(value))



146#endif



147



148/**



149* @brief 32 bits bits setting macro.



150*/



151#if !defined(REG_BIT_SET32)



152  #define REG_BIT_SET32(address, mask)      ((*(volatile uint32_t*)(address))|= (uint32_t)(mask))



153#endif



154



155/**



156* @brief 32 bits bits clearing macro.



157*/



158#if !defined(REG_BIT_CLEAR32)



159  #define REG_BIT_CLEAR32(address, mask)    ((*(volatile uint32_t*)(address))&= ((uint32_t)~((uint32_t)(mask))))



160#endif



161



162/**



163* @brief 32 bit clear bits and set with new value



164* @note It is user's responsability to make sure that value has only "mask" bits set - (value&~mask)==0



165*/



166#if !defined(REG_RMW32)



167  #define REG_RMW32(address, mask, value)   (REG_WRITE32((address), ((REG_READ32(address)& ((uint32_t)~((uint32_t)(mask))))| ((uint32_t)(value)))))



168#endif

17025/** SPI - Register Layout Typedef */



17026typedef struct {



17027  __IO uint32_t MCR;                               /**< Module Configuration Register, offset: 0x0 */



17028       uint8_t RESERVED_0[4];



17029  __IO uint32_t TCR;                               /**< Transfer Count Register, offset: 0x8 */



17030  union {                                          /* offset: 0xC */



17031    __IO uint32_t CTAR[SPI_CTAR_COUNT];              /**< Clock and Transfer Attributes Register (In Master Mode), array offset: 0xC, array step: 0x4 */



17032    __IO uint32_t CTAR_SLAVE[SPI_CTAR_SLAVE_COUNT];  /**< Clock and Transfer Attributes Register (In Slave Mode), array offset: 0xC, array step: 0x4 */



17033  } MODE;



17034       uint8_t RESERVED_1[16];



17035  __IO uint32_t SR;                                /**< Status Register, offset: 0x2C */



17036  __IO uint32_t RSER;                              /**< DMA/Interrupt Request Select and Enable Register, offset: 0x30 */



17037  union {                                          /* offset: 0x34 */



17038    struct {                                         /* offset: 0x34 */



17039      __IO uint16_t CMD;                               /**< SPI_2_PUSHR_FIFO_CMD register...SPI_1_PUSHR_FIFO_CMD register., offset: 0x34 */



17040      __IO uint16_t TX;                                /**< SPI_2_PUSHR_FIFO_TX register...SPI_1_PUSHR_FIFO_TX register., offset: 0x36 */



17041    } FIFO;



17042    __IO uint32_t PUSHR;                             /**< PUSH TX FIFO Register In Master Mode, offset: 0x34 */



17043    __IO uint32_t SLAVE;                             /**< PUSH TX FIFO Register In Slave Mode, offset: 0x34 */



17044  } PUSHR;



17045  __I  uint32_t POPR;                              /**< POP RX FIFO Register, offset: 0x38 */



17046  __I  uint32_t TXFR[SPI_TXFR_COUNT];              /**< Transmit FIFO Registers, array offset: 0x3C, array step: 0x4 */



17047       uint8_t RESERVED_2[44];



17048  __I  uint32_t RXFR[SPI_RXFR_COUNT];              /**< Receive FIFO Registers, array offset: 0x7C, array step: 0x4 */



17049} SPI_Type, *SPI_MemMapPtr;
